    'Chorro unhaiṅ kehti rahi': 'Chhoro unheṅ kehti rahi',
    'Zulm o sitam ke tute': 'Zulm o sitam ke tute',
    'Aise paharr baba': 'Aise pahaar baba',
    'Parrte agar dino pe': 'Parte agar dinoṅ pe',
    'Ho jate wo siyah(ha)': 'Ho jaate wo siyaah-ha',
    'Shab pe agar ye parrtay': 'Shab pe agar ye girte',
    'Din may badal wo jata': 'Din meiṅ badal wo jaata',

    'Na to un ki pairawi ki': 'Na to un ki pairavi ki',
    'Gardan may bhi rassi thi': 'Gardan meiṅ bhi rassi thi',
    'May zamin par parri thi': 'Maiṅ zamin par pari thi',
    'Mera hath baba jis ke': 'Mera haath baba jis ke',
    'Tu ne hath may diya tha': 'Tu ne haath meiṅ diya tha',
    'De raha huṅ may amanat': 'De raha huṅ maiṅ amaanat',
    'Haqqe Ali ki khatir': 'Haqq-e-Ali ki khaatir',
    'Mangi gawahi jab to': 'Maangi gawaahi jab to',
    'Us jalte dar ke piche': 'Us jalte dar ke pichhe',
    'Thi teri beti Zahra': 'Thi teri beti Zahra',
    'Jhutlaya mujh ko baba': 'Jhutlaaya mujh ko baba',
    'Hasanal ko us ne bhaya': 'Hasan al ko us ne bhaaya',
    'Mujh se gawah mangaya': 'Mujh se gawaah mangaaya',
    'Meri aik bhi na maana': 'Meri ek bhi na maana',
    'Mujhe tazyani maara': 'Mujhe taaziyaana maara',
    'Zara rehm bhi na khaya': 'Zara rahm bhi na khaaya',
    'Haq apna mangne may': 'Haq apna maangne meiṅ',
    'Darbar may gayi jo': 'Darbaar meiṅ gayi jo',
    'Tehqir kar ke meri': 'Tahqir kar ke meri',
    'The dante mujhe wo': 'The daante mujhe wo',
    'Baatil ke rukh se parda': 'Baatil ke rukh se parda',
    'Kar ke bayaṅ wilayat': 'Kar ke bayaaṅ wilaayat',
    'Zehra ne hai batay': 'Zehra ne hai bataaya',
    'Yehi asal e zindagi hai': 'Yehi asal-e-zindagi hai',
}
lines = roman.decode().split('\\n')
assert changes.keys() <= {line.strip() for line in lines}
updated = '\\n'.join('  ' + changes.get(line[2:], line[2:]) if line else '' for line in lines)
source = body.decode().strip().split('\\n\\n')
blocks = updated.split('\\n\\n')
assert len(source) == len(blocks) == 19
for i, (left, right) in enumerate(zip(source, blocks), 1):
    urdu, latin = left.splitlines(), right.splitlines()
    assert urdu[0].translate(str.maketrans('۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹','0123456789')) == latin[0].strip() == str(i)
    assert len(urdu) == len(latin)
assert all(ord(c) < 128 or c in 'ṅṄ' for c in updated)
p.write_bytes(head + b'romanLyrics: |-\\n' + updated.encode() + b'\\n---\\n' + body)
saved = p.read_bytes()
assert saved.split(b'romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[0] == head
assert saved.split(b'\\n---\\n', 1)[1] == body
